1.synopsis: Tamsin Vey wades in the reed pond of the Silver Reed Sect, and Elder Kovic Brannoch tells her she has reached the third layer of Mist Gathering.

entities.name: Tamsin Vey
entities.summary: A fifteen-year-old disciple of the Silver Reed Sect.

entities.name: Kovic Brannoch
entities.summary: An elder of the Silver Reed Sect who carries a reed flute he never plays.

entities.name: Silver Reed Sect
entities.summary: A sect in a valley of tall grey reeds.

entities.name: Mist Gathering
entities.summary: The first realm, split into nine layers.

entities.name: Dace Mullery
entities.summary: A tall older disciple of the Silver Reed Sect.

facts.claim: Tamsin is fifteen and kneels at the reed pond of the Silver Reed Sect.
quotes: Tamsin Vey was fifteen the spring she knelt at the edge of the reed pond of the Silver Reed Sect

facts.claim: Mist Gathering is the first realm, which every cultivator climbs first.
quotes: Mist Gathering is the first realm, and every cultivator under heaven climbs it before anything else.

facts.claim: Mist Gathering has nine layers, from the first layer to the ninth layer.
quotes: It has nine layers, from the first layer to the ninth layer

facts.claim: Tamsin has reached the third layer of Mist Gathering.
quotes: Tamsin Vey has reached the third layer of Mist Gathering.
Breathe the way I showed you.

2.synopsis: Tamsin reaches the seventh layer of Mist Gathering, and Kovic tells her of Root Binding, the second realm.

entities.name: Root Binding
entities.summary: The second realm, with an early stage, a middle stage and a late stage.

facts.claim: Tamsin has reached the seventh layer of Mist Gathering.
quotes: Tamsin Vey has reached the seventh layer of Mist Gathering

facts.claim: Root Binding is the second realm.
quotes: Root Binding is the second realm

facts.claim: Root Binding has an early stage, a middle stage and a late stage.
quotes: Root Binding has an early stage, a middle stage and a late stage.

facts.claim: Dace has stood in the early stage of Root Binding since the spring.
quotes: he had stood in the early stage of Root Binding since the spring

3.synopsis: Tamsin loses a bout to Dace Mullery in the winter contest but reaches the ninth layer of Mist Gathering.

facts.claim: Tamsin lost her bout against Dace.
quotes: She lost the bout in the time it took the reeds to bow twice

facts.claim: Tamsin has reached the ninth layer of Mist Gathering.
quotes: Tamsin Vey has reached the ninth layer of Mist Gathering

4.synopsis: Tamsin breaks through to the early stage of Root Binding, and Kovic tells her of Pearl Forming, the third realm.

entities.name: Pearl Forming
entities.summary: The third realm, where a cultivator forms a single pearl.

facts.claim: Tamsin has broken through to the early stage of Root Binding.
quotes: Tamsin Vey has broken through to the early stage of Root Binding

facts.claim: Pearl Forming is the third realm.
quotes: Pearl Forming is the third realm.

facts.claim: Nobody in the sect has formed a pearl in forty years.
quotes: Nobody in this sect has formed a pearl in forty years.
